name: sat-study-system
description: Turns the College Board SAT question bank into timed, handwritable study sheets for the Supernote, driven by a 100-type taxonomy of SAT maths questions.
author: Franco Gómez Schumacher

scripts.verify: swift tools/verify_index.swift data/qb_index.json && swift tools/verify_index.swift data/rw_index.json
scripts.test: node --test tools/*.test.mjs && python3 tools/types_state.test.py && python3 tools/merge_assignments.test.py && python3 tools/check_taxonomy.test.py
